name: openvino
description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
one_liner: A free toolkit from Intel that makes AI models run faster and cheaper on ordinary laptop and server chips instead of needing expensive specialized GPUs.
buyer: A hardware-constrained startup (e.g. an edge-AI device maker) that needs to run AI inference on cheap chips without paying for GPU cloud time.
business_use_cases: An edge-device manufacturer (cameras, kiosks, retail sensors) bakes OpenVINO in to run AI features on-device, cheaply.
A systems integrator offers 'cut your AI cloud bill in half' consulting by porting clients' models to run on CPU with OpenVINO.
A retail analytics company runs in-store camera AI locally instead of streaming video to the cloud, avoiding bandwidth and privacy costs.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid model-optimization/porting consulting for companies with high GPU inference bills.
Bundle an OpenVINO-optimized model into a sellable edge-AI hardware kit.

steal_this: Take one popular open vision model, optimize it with OpenVINO, and sell it as a drop-in 'runs on any laptop, no GPU needed' package to indie hackers.
